end.summary:
Practised speed, average speed, velocity, and acceleration.
Calculated acceleration, including negative acceleration, using a = (v − u)/t; 2 unaided answers were correct.
Calculated average velocity as displacement ÷ time and distinguished velocity from speed; 1 unaided answer was correct.
Initially linked acceleration only with speeding up; later explained that velocity change includes direction change.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: At home, ask them to explain one example where an object changes direction at constant speed and say why its velocity changes.
